title: 第104章 众人震惊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 全场瞬间一片死寂！所有人都被皇帝的话给震住了。皇帝说什么？唐逸是小诗仙？怎么可能？唐逸怎么可能是小诗仙！他们可是辛辛苦苦查过了，唐逸明明只是小诗仙的替身。替身怎么忽然就成正牌了？！“父……父皇，您……您说什么呢？您搞错了吧？”片刻，太子猛地抬起头，错愕地看向炎文帝。这个答案他不接受！唐逸只是个垃圾，垃圾就该待在垃圾堆中，这是他对唐逸的定义和结论。现在，炎文帝竟然告诉他，他的结论是错的。唐逸是小诗仙，名动京都的小诗仙！开什么玩笑？！“搞错？这种事，朕还能搞错吗？”唐逸看着众人震惊的脸色，脸上那是一个得意。对对对，就是这个表情，朕就喜欢看你们这一脸见了鬼的表情。不过，还不够，给你们的惊喜，现在才刚刚开始……他指着唐逸，冲着众人笑道：“朕很确定，小诗仙就是唐逸，唐逸就是小诗仙。”“哼，早就告诉你们了，我哥哥就是小诗仙。”唐音气鼓鼓的声音也传来。此时，炎文帝正将她抱在胸前，她一只手揽着皇帝的脖子，一只手叉在腰上，精致的小脸上满是得意。哼哼，让你们不信。现在，信了没？“我的美人诗，也是出自唐四少之手。”杜凌菲唇角微扬，轻声附和。唐逸当日随手写给她的那首美人诗，早就在京都传开了，只是因为要隐藏唐逸的身份，当时敲定的诗名没有用。到目前为止，只知道这首诗是写给一个婢女的，还没有人知道这首诗是写给她的。《清平调·赠杜凌菲》！现在，终于可以让世人知道，这首诗是写她的了。“哈哈，唐逸小子，这段时间别人不知道，就老夫知道，知道却不能和别人分享，差点将老夫给憋死了！”“老夫证明，他就是小诗仙！”“老夫当日在状元街，用来打你们脸的那首什么什么给老夫以壮之的词，就是这小子写的。”狄苍的狂笑声传遍全场，知道唐逸身份的就只有那么几个人，他就是其中之一。这段时间他知道真相，却又不能和别人分享，差点就将他给憋坏了。“我也可以证明，其实我真是小诗仙……”唐逸举拳抵唇，干咳两声。手却下意识压在腰间的绣春刀上，昂首挺胸，睥睨全场！好吧，既然要打脸，那就狠狠打！闻言，全场所有人都瞠目结舌。有皇帝，有狄苍亲自作证，他们就算再不信，也只能接受事实。唐逸，就是小诗仙！“不可能，这不可能，不可能！”唐敬猛地抬起头，看着站在炎文帝身前的唐逸，整个人如同被雷劈了一般，近乎石化在当场。他脑袋一片空白，思绪也在这一刻停止了。唐逸一直在他印象中都是懦弱无能，只会搬弄是非的废物，要才华没才华，要修养没修养，他连给大儿子唐画提鞋都不配。现在，皇帝却说……唐逸就是小诗仙。那个凭借几首诗词，生生将朝局搅成一锅粥的小诗仙！那个为武将站台，用几首诗词生生在他们脸上碾过的小诗仙！这是不可能的，一定是陛下搞错了。对，肯定是陛下搞错了！“不，他是废物，他是废物啊！废物怎么可能是小诗仙。”颜霜玉此时也是目瞪口呆，眼睛瞪得宛如两个铜铃，满脸的难以置信。陛下说什么？唐逸是小诗仙？是那个名动京都无数人想要求见一面的小诗仙？这不可能，这几年唐逸都被她看得死死的，每天半点空闲都不给他，天天让他累成狗。他连书籍都没摸过，他字都认不全，他能是小诗仙？肯定是哪里出问题了。“他是小诗仙？不是，他不是小诗仙。”“他连给画哥哥提鞋都不配，他怎么能是小诗仙？”姜云娜也破防了，如果不是死死捂住嘴，她都忍不住尖叫，冷声质问皇帝了。唐画，那是她的完美男神，而唐逸，不过路边狗屎一般的垃圾。现在，皇帝却说那不是垃圾，不是狗屎？那是黄金，是举世瞩目的明珠？！“什么？不，不，这不可能！”唐画瞪着唐逸，一双眼睛已经泛红，脸上更是青筋了起来。唐逸是小诗仙？是那个写了他抄袭的《劝谏诗》的小诗仙？那个令无数大儒闻风丧胆的小诗仙？那个将满朝文武，戏耍得团团转的小诗仙？这不可能，他没有这本事，他怎么可能会有这本事。而他身侧的唐浩，此时已经吓得脸色煞白，几乎趴在了地上，甚至下意识地在手臂上狠狠咬了一口。贼疼！不是做梦，唐逸真是小诗仙。刘州已经抬起头，只是此时盯着唐逸的目光已经开始涣散，嘴巴更是张得能吞下自己的拳头。唐逸是小诗仙！那他还需要买诗词？自己写的诗词还需要买？妈的，难怪当晚梁绍会信心百倍带唐逸找他单挑，难怪当晚幻音坊的事情后梁绍一群人会被锦衣卫抓了。原来，梁绍从一开始就知道唐逸的身份，他说诗词是他买给唐逸的，只是为了误导他而已。而他，信了。刘温，赵轲一群人大臣也傻了，一个个目瞪口呆。这段时间，为了将小诗仙这害虫抓出来，他们几乎使尽浑身解数，结果小诗仙没找到，只找到了皇帝给小诗仙找的替身。原本以为皇帝是想要唐逸吸引所有人的仇恨，以隐藏小诗仙的存在。却没想到，特妈的仇恨从一开始，就没有给错人啊！替身和正牌，是同一个人！“什么？他竟然就是小诗仙！”宇文封眼睛死死盯着唐逸，杀意腾腾。他查过唐逸，知道唐逸不过是唐家的小废物。但这小废物，竟然是让北狄损失惨重的罪魁祸首。“今日，你必死！”于文封攥紧拳头，杀意锁定唐逸，差点忍不住当场扑杀过去。东虞使馆处，言锋脸皮也都在轻微抽搐，咬牙切齿道：“呵，真没想到，真相竟然是这样。”秦钰虽然有点震惊，却不是太意外。“我早说过，去掉一切的可能，最不可能的可能就是答案！”
content_en: The whole place fell into dead silence for an instant!Everyone was shocked by the emperor's words.What did the emperor say?Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy?How is that possible?How could Tang Yi be a little poetry fairy!They had worked hard to check, and it turned out that Tang Yi was just Xiao Shixian's stand-in.Why did the substitute suddenly become the real deal?!"Father...Father, you...what did you say? Are you mistaken?" After a moment, the prince suddenly raised his head and looked at Emperor Yanwen in surprise.He doesn't accept this answer!Tang Yi is just garbage, and garbage should stay in the garbage heap. This is his definition and conclusion of Tang Yi.Now, Emperor Yanwen actually told him that his conclusion was wrong.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy, a little poetry fairy who is famous in Kyoto!Are you kidding me?!"Make a mistake? Can I still make a mistake in this kind of thing?" Tang Yi looked at the shocked faces of everyone, with a proud look on his face.Yes, yes, that's the expression. I just like to see the ghostly expression on your face.However, it is not enough. The surprise for you has just begun... He pointed at Tang Yi and smiled at everyone: "I am very sure that the little Poet Fairy is Tang Yi, and Tang Yi is the Little Poet Fairy." "Huh, I told you a long time ago, my brother is the Little Poet Fairy." Tang Yin's angry voice also came.At this time, Emperor Yanwen was holding her against his chest. She had one hand around the emperor's neck and one hand on her waist. Her delicate little face was full of pride.Hum hum, you don’t believe it.Now, do you believe it?"My beauty poems were also written by the Fourth Young Master of Tang Dynasty." Du Lingfei raised the corners of her lips and agreed softly.The beauty poem that Tang Yi casually wrote to her that day had already spread in Kyoto. Just because he wanted to hide Tang Yi's identity, the title of the poem that was finalized at that time was useless.So far, it is only known that this poem was written to a maidservant, and no one knows that this poem was written to her."Qing Ping Tiao·Gift to Du Lingfei"!Now, the world can finally know that this poem is about her."Haha, boy Tang Yi, no one else knows about it during this time, but I know it. I know it but can't share it with others. I almost suffocated me to death!" "I prove that he is the little poetry fairy!" "The song that I used to slap you in the face that day to cheer me up was written by this boy." Di Cang's wild laughter spread throughout the audience. There were only a few people who knew Tang Yi's identity, and he was one of them.During this time, he knew the truth, but he couldn't share it with others, which almost choked him."I can also prove that I am actually a little poetry fairy..." Tang Yi raised his fist to his lips and coughed twice.However, his hand subconsciously pressed on the embroidered spring knife at his waist, and he held his head high and stared at the audience!Well, if you want to be slapped in the face, let’s slap it hard!Hearing this, everyone in the audience was stunned.With the emperor and Di Cang personally testifying, even if they didn't believe it, they could only accept the facts.Tang Yi is the little poetry fairy!"Impossible, this is impossible, impossible!" Tang Jing suddenly raised his head and looked at Tang Yi, who was standing in front of Emperor Yan Wen. His whole body seemed to have been struck by lightning, and he was almost petrified on the spot.His mind went blank, and his thoughts stopped at this moment.Tang Yi has always been in his mind as a cowardly and incompetent trash who only knows how to tell trouble. He has no talent but no talent and no cultivation. He is not even worthy of carrying his eldest son Tang Hua's shoes.Now, the emperor said... Tang Yi is the little poetry fairy.That little poet who turned the court into a pot of porridge with just a few poems!That little poetry fairy who stood up for the generals and rubbed them in the face with a few poems!This is impossible. His Majesty must have made a mistake.Yes, His Majesty must have made a mistake!"No, he is a waste, he is a waste! How can the waste be a little poetry fairy." Yan Shuangyu was also stunned at this time, her eyes were as wide as two copper bells, and her face was full of disbelief.What did your Majesty say?Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy?Is it the little poetry fairy who is so famous that countless people in Kyoto want to meet him?This is impossible. She has been obsessed with Tang Yi for the past few years. She doesn't give him any free time every day and makes him exhausted every day.He has never even touched a book, and he cannot recognize all the characters. How can he be a little poetry fairy?Something must be wrong."He is the Little Poet Fairy? No, he is not the Little Poet Fairy." "He is not even worthy of carrying Brother Hua's shoes, how can he be the Little Poet Fairy?" Jiang Yunna also broke her guard. If she hadn't covered her mouth tightly, she couldn't help but scream, and asked the emperor coldly.Tang Hua was her perfect boyfriend, while Tang Yi was nothing more than dog shit-like garbage on the roadside.Now, the emperor says that it is not garbage or shit?Is that gold, a pearl that attracts worldwide attention?!"What? No, no, this is impossible!" Tang Hua stared at Tang Yi, his eyes already red, and veins on his face.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy?Is it the little poetry fairy who wrote the "Poem of Admonition" that he plagiarized?That little poetry fairy who made countless great scholars afraid of him?That little poetry fairy who played around with all the civil and military officials in the dynasty?This is impossible, he doesn't have this ability, how could he have this ability.Tang Hao, who was beside him, turned pale with fright, almost lying on the ground, and even subconsciously bit his arm hard.It hurts!It's not a dream, Tang Yi is really a little poetry fairy.Liu Zhou had already raised his head, but his gaze on Tang Yi had begun to wander, and his mouth was open enough to swallow his fist.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy!Then he still needs to buy poems?Do I still need to buy poems I wrote?Damn it, no wonder Liang Shao was so confident that night that he brought Tang Yi to challenge him. No wonder Liang Shao and his group were arrested by Jinyiwei after what happened at Huanyinfang that night.It turned out that Liang Shao knew Tang Yi's identity from the beginning. He said that he bought the poems for Tang Yi just to mislead him.And he believed it.Liu Wen, Zhao Ke, a group of ministers were also dumbfounded, and they were all dumbfounded.During this period, in order to catch the pest Xiao Shixian, they almost tried their best. However, they did not find Xiao Shixian and only found the substitute that the emperor had found for Xiao Shixian.I originally thought that the emperor wanted Tang Yi to attract everyone's hatred in order to hide the existence of Xiao Shixian.But I didn’t expect that Special Mom’s hatred was not given to the wrong person from the beginning!The substitute and the real one are the same person!"What? He is actually the Little Poet Fairy!" Yu Wenfeng stared at Tang Yi with murderous intent.He checked Tang Yi and knew that Tang Yi was just a little waste of the Tang family.But this little waste turned out to be the culprit of Beidi's heavy losses."Today, you will die!" Yu Wenfeng clenched his fists, targeting Tang Yi with murderous intent, and almost couldn't help but kill him on the spot.At the Dongyu Embassy, ​​Yan Feng was too shameless
